sources.title: TryNihongo, JLPT N3 December 2024 reference answers

limitations: These are independent reference keys, not an official JLPT answer sheet.
Question 47 option 4 also sounds plausible in ordinary conversation; the two references select option 2, but the item context does not fully disambiguate the alternatives.
Question 48 option 1 is grammatically possible as a reason; the references select option 2. The explanation records this limitation instead of claiming option 1 is structurally impossible.
